CRITICAL fixed: the Make.com comparison table was wrong on the two cells a reader uses to pick a plan. Core is $9/mo, not $10.59, and a 1-minute scheduling interval is available on EVERY paid tier, not 'Pro plan only'; only Free is capped, at 15 minutes. The old table overstated the entry cost of the skill's own flagship polling pattern by 78%. Verified against make.com/en/pricing.

CRITICAL fixed: 'Monday.com API v1 is maintained only until May 1, 2026' was a category error repeated in five places. monday.com has no v1/v2 axis: api.monday.com/v2 is the GraphQL ENDPOINT path, and API versions are DATE-based (2026-04 maintenance, 2026-07 current, 2026-10 RC), selected per request with an API-Version header, with at least six months' deprecation notice. No May 1 2026 date exists anywhere on the versioning page. Replaced with correct guidance in all five locations.

CRITICAL fixed (both halves wrong): the skill said an invoice without an allocation number 'renders them invalid'. gov.il says the number is required `כתנאי לניכוי מס התשומות`, i.e. it is a condition of the RECIPIENT's input-VAT deduction, not of the invoice's validity. The invoice is not void; the buyer cannot deduct. That changes who the automation must alert. And the skill never stated that the threshold is measured BEFORE VAT (`כשסכום העסקה לפני מע"מ גבוה מ-5,000 ₪`), so a scenario filtering on the gross document total over-requests an allocation number on every invoice between roughly 4,238 and 5,000 NIS net. Both fixed in both languages plus the Gotchas.

Removed an invented legislative event: the threshold table carried a 'Jan 1, 2027 | 5,000 NIS (planned to continue)' row and three passages saying the threshold 'is scheduled to drop again'. The published schedule terminates at 5,000 NIS from 1 June 2026; searching gov.il for 2027 returns nothing. The configurable-variable advice was kept but re-justified on maintainability rather than a phantom schedule.

Fixed (Judge, uncited and wrong by ~500x): references/make-israeli-modules.md gave the monday.com limit as '10,000 complexity/min'. It is a complexity BUDGET: 5M points/min each for reads and writes on an app token, a combined 10M/min on a personal token (1M for trial/NGO/free), with a 5M cap per query. A reader sizing a polling scenario against 10,000 would throttle a scenario with ~500x the headroom. The Morning and WhatsApp rate-limit rows in the same table are uncited vendor numbers and are now labelled as needing confirmation rather than presented as established.

De-asserted rather than re-guessed (Judge): the payroll table put the Bituach Leumi employer payment on the 10th, uncited. The Judge says the statutory date is the 15th of the following month. I could not confirm EITHER day against a Bituach Leumi page (the obvious candidates 404 and the employer landing pages do not state a day), so rather than swapping one unverified figure for another the row now says mid-month, names the dispute, warns against scheduling on the 10th, and tells the reader to confirm for their own תיק ניכויים. RESOLVE THIS NEXT CYCLE with a real citation: it is a penalty-bearing obligation.

Fixed dead endpoint: `http://api.inforu.co.il/SendMessage.asmx` does not resolve at all (HTTP 000). The live endpoints are https://api.inforu.co.il/SendMessageXml.ashx (200, returns a real XML error body) and https://capi.inforu.co.il/api/v2/SMS/SendSms (401, auth-gated). Negative control: an undefined sibling path returns 404, so the 200 is path-specific and not a blanket response.

Added the Form 126 employer wage-reconciliation dates, carried from the previous cycle: 18 July (Jan-Jun of that year), 18 January (Jan-Dec of the preceding year) and 30 April (preceding tax year, section 166 extension). The day is the 18th, NOT month-end, which is where a scenario on a month-end schedule silently misses it. The previous cycle's note said 'mid-Jul / mid-Jan'; do not ship that approximation.

Re-verified unchanged against primary sources: BL employer 4.51%/7.60% and employee 1.04%/7.00%, health employee-only 3.23%/5.17%, reduced threshold 7,703 NIS, ceiling 51,910 NIS (all effective 01.01.2026); VAT 18%; Make MCP scenario-run timeouts 25s OAuth / 40s token (promoted from UNVERIFIED last cycle to verified); Tranzila npay = additional payments so total = npay + 1 (also promoted); Morning still Callbox-built and actions-only on api.greeninvoice.co.il with decimal shekels.

Resolved the 'Best plan' gap: 'Best' is not a tier in Make's current lineup (Free / Core / Pro / Teams / Enterprise). The Callbox app page does say it, so the skill now reports it as the vendor's legacy wording, tells the reader not to shop for a plan by that name, and points at iCount, which has a native first-party module with no tier gate. NOTE: my first pass fixed the English and left a stale 'שדרגו ל-Best' sentence in the Hebrew troubleshooting entry, directly contradicting the corrected paragraph above it. Caught by the Judge. When a troubleshooting entry is split across `סיבה:` and `פתרון:` lines, edit BOTH.
